title: Space bound for the split solver
statement: For all natural numbers $C$, $e$, and $t$, and every Boolean word $x$, the total number of distinct work-tape cells visited by the machine defined by the split solver with parameters $C$ and $e$, starting from its initial configuration on $x$ and running for $t$ steps, is at most $23$ times its number of work tapes, times $\bigl((C+1+5e)2^e+46\bigr)(|x|+1)^{e+1}$.
